description: This file defines classes for streaming iterators that handle responses from the Google Interactions API, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous streaming of Server-Sent Events (SSE). It includes base and derived classes for processing response chunks, managing logging, and handling response completion.

classes.name: BaseInteractionsAPIStreamingIterator
classes.description: Base class providing shared logic for streaming iterators that process responses from the Interactions API, including chunk processing and response handling.

classes.name: InteractionsAPIStreamingIterator
classes.description: Asynchronous iterator class for streaming responses from the Interactions API, supporting async iteration and logging.

classes.name: SyncInteractionsAPIStreamingIterator
classes.description: Synchronous iterator class for streaming responses from the Interactions API, supporting standard iteration and logging.

methods.name: _process_chunk
methods.description: Processes a single data chunk from the stream, parsing JSON and handling SSE format, including detection of completion marker.

methods.name: _handle_logging_completed_response
methods.description: Handles logging when a streaming response is marked as completed; overridden in subclasses for async and sync contexts.
